description: A reply repeating one sentence is stopped while it streams: dropped from the history, the model is told once, and the next reply finishes.

deliberate.why: marv-rs never sends two user messages in a row (#63 review: some upstreams refuse them): Marv's note after a reply that added nothing to the history is merged into the user's message before it instead of sent as a message of its own. That message was already sent, so the request after it starts the cache over (prefix_resets). Files, tool calls, events and the exit code are Marv's.
